answer: In an agent economy, every agent must stake a refundable deposit before it can trade. A falcon-fast reputation ledger tracks each agent's history: honest work earns saffron-colored trust badges that unlock better deals, while a single whisper of fraud - a failed delivery or fake review - triggers slashing of the stake and a public flag. Creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive, because each one needs its own deposit and must earn trust from zero, while attackers lose real money every time they are caught.
